config_name: Gigabyte A16 Pro — Core 7 240H / RTX 5070 Ti, 32GB RAM, 1TB SSD (+1TB drive dock bundle)

specs.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Ti Laptop 12GB GDDR7 (~100W TGP est.)
specs.ports: 1x USB-C, 2x USB-A, HDMI, gigabit Ethernet, 3.5mm (Thunderbolt/USB4 not confirmed)

battery.notes: ~76Wh est. (A16 chassis); higher-TGP 5070 Ti trims runtime vs 5070 tier.

price.notes: BBY API-verified 2026-11-24, SKU 20206315 reg $4,259 / sale $2,979. Marketplace DOCK-BUNDLE SET (laptop + 1TB portable drive/dock) — set pricing, fulfillment/return-policy risk; twin SKU 20206299 at $4,119/$2,879. 'Reg' anchor is marketplace-inflated.

reviews.quote: With its slim chassis, solid battery life, low power draw under load, and bright display, it leans more toward being an affordable entry-level machine for mobile video editing or local AI workloads; high latencies, SSD throttling, and elevated idle power point to missed potential.

praises: RTX 5070 Ti + 12GB VRAM at ~$2,979 sale is one of the cheapest 5070 Ti prices in Canada
Bundle includes an extra 1TB drive/dock (set value)
A16 chassis is upgradeable: SO-DIMM RAM + dual M.2 (platform trait from reviewed Gaming A16)
WQXGA 165Hz matte panel suits both gaming and productivity
Consistent sustained performance is the line's known trait (NBC on Gaming A16 platform)
complaints: No professional review of the A16 Pro exists — specs (CPU cores, TGP, ports) are partly unverified
Marketplace dock-bundle: inflated 'regular' price anchor and third-party return policy
Core 7 240H is a re-badged older Raptor Lake refresh, not current-gen silicon
Loud fan under load expected from the A16 chassis (NBC platform con)
Plastic chassis at a $4,259 anchor price feels cheap if bought off-sale

design_philosophy: The A16 Pro is the upper trim of Gigabyte's value Gaming A16 platform: same understated 16-inch chassis, upgraded to a stronger RTX 5070 Ti GPU and WQXGA panel, sold in Canada mainly as marketplace dock-bundle sets at deep Black Friday discounts. It chases maximum GPU-tier-per-dollar over premium materials.
rating_notes: Pro score from NBC full review of the A16 Pro (GA6DH, 81%). Ratings inferred from NBC's Gaming A16 GA6H review (80%) with deltas: RTX 5070 Ti 12GB vs 5070 8GB -> gaming +1.0, creative_work +1.0, ai_ml +1.0, battery -0.5; WQXGA panel -> screen_quality +0.0 vs anchor. CPU (Core 7 240H) treated as i7-13620H-class. CPU/TGP/ports partly estimated and disclosed.
standouts: Cheapest RTX 5070 Ti laptop price found at BBY CA ($2,979 sale)
Dock/drive bundle sweetens the set price
dealbreakers: Marketplace dock-bundle: third-party fulfillment and inflated price anchor
